title: Vogue Williams and Spencer Matthews reveal name of fourth child
summary: Vogue Williams and Spencer Matthews have revealed the name of their fourth child. The couple announced the name, referencing Disney, on social media. They also shared the first photograph of the baby. Williams and Matthews are parents to three other children.
summary_points: Vogue Williams and Spencer Matthews have named their fourth child.
The name is inspired by Disney.
The couple shared the first photo of the baby.
Williams and Matthews have three other children.
title_hi: वोग विलियम्स और स्पेंसर मैथ्यूज ने चौथे बच्चे का नाम बताया

summary_points_hi: वोग विलियम्स और स्पेंसर मैथ्यूज ने अपने चौथे बच्चे का नाम रखा है।
